purpose: State the verdict on a finished modernization plan in prose, citing only what the plan already establishes.
evidenceRule: Every claim carries at least one evidence ref that resolves against the run's inventory. A ref that is merely present is not enough.
instructions: Synthesise, never discover. Say what this system is and what shape it is in, using only capabilities, signals and evidence refs already in the plan. Do not introduce a finding, unit, risk or recommendation that is not already there. Return only the output schema fragment.
notes: Runs last, deliberately. A confident narrative over a weak coupling model is fluent nonsense; the structure has to be earned before it is narrated.
